briefTitle: Chemotherapy Combined With Immunotherapy Versus Immunotherapy Alone for Older Adults With Stage IIIB-IV Lung Cancer, The ACHIEVE Trial

typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must have Stage IIIB, IIIC or IV disease and not be candidates for combined chemo-radiation. NOTE: Prior chemo-radiation therapy (RT) for stage III with recurrence is allowed
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patient must have Stage IIIB, IIIC or IV disease and not be candidates for combined chemo-radiation. NOTE: Prior chemo-radiation therapy (RT) for stage III with recurrence is allowed

typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must have a tumor that is negative for EGFR mutation/ALK translocations or other actionable first line mutations in which patients would receive first-line oral tyrosine kinase inhibitors

typedChecks.sourceText: Patient must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0-2

typedChecks.sourceText: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1,500/uL (obtained within 14 days prior to Step 1 registration)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have the ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document. Patients with impaired decision-making capacity (IDMC) who have a legally authorized representative (LAR) or caregiver and/or family member available will also be considered eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to sign informed consent and decision-making capacity are subjective criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must be English or Spanish speaking to be eligible for the QOL component of the study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Language requirement for quality-of-life component is not a typed clinical check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have had any prior cytotoxic chemotherapy regimen for metastatic disease. Chemotherapy given in the setting of adjuvant therapy or locally advanced disease is allowed as long as treatment was completed, and they have fully recovered from treatment related adverse events prior to Step 1 registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior chemotherapy exclusion has complex exceptions regarding metastatic setting versus adjuvant or locally advanced settings.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have had any prior immunotherapy for metastatic disease. Immunotherapy given in the setting of adjuvant therapy or locally advanced disease is allowed as long as treatment was completed greater than 6 months prior to Step 1 registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior immunotherapy exclusion has complex time windows and setting dependencies.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not have a history of uncontrolled autoimmune conditions with the following exceptions, which are allowed: alopecia, vitiligo, rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis/psoriatic arthritis, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, lupus, inflammatory bowel disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled autoimmune conditions and multiple specific exceptions require subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must not be on immunosuppressive medication, including steroids (if doses exceed the equivalent of prednisone 10 mg daily). Short courses of steroids which are discontinued prior to randomization are acceptable. Patients on inhaled, intranasal and/or topical steroids are eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immunosuppressive medication and steroid equivalent dosing involve complex rule evaluations.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have baseline imaging done assessing all measurable or non-measurable sites of disease within 45 days prior to Step 1 registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Baseline imaging assessment is a procedural requirement rather than a typed biomarker or lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Investigator must declare their intended chemotherapy regimen should their patient be randomized to Arm B (doublet versus[vs] singlet)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator declaration of treatment regimen is a trial administrative requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must have completed the baseline Geriatric Assessment (GA) after Step 1 registration and prior to Step 2 randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Completion of geriatric assessment is a study process requirement.
